prompt_full_example:
retro-futuristic science-fiction ENVIRONMENT concept art, Syd Mead and John Berkey influence, clean digital painting, Concord game concept art style language like Sung Choi, sharp readable forms, polished concept art finish

SUBJECT AS INHABITED MEGASTRUCTURE: a colossal cat-shaped ancient-tech wreck standing upright, treated like Gloom robot-skull settlement — hollowed used-future habitat of LARGE CLEAN oxidized teal hard-surface panels with rivets only at seams, scaffolding catwalks and a few colored awnings climbing on armor cracks, small amber window lights and limited neon pink-cyan glow leaking from chest and helmet gaps, cat head graphic hard-edge planar forms large flat color blocks, NO fur, NO whiskers, NO photoreal face, industrial girder-like greatsword planted as structural pillar with a few platforms, NOT magic sword

SCALE: L1 inhabited cat wreck + Halo industrial ring + huge pink-purple moon, L2 midground settlement readable but NOT cluttered — scaffolding shacks awnings on ruins and cat armor like Akkar but keep shapes clean and grouped, L3 tiny people and tiny ships with white contrails

ENVIRONMENT: bright cyan-blue daytime sky large continuous clean negative space, huge pale pink-purple moon, industrial Halo ring with clean teal oxidized plating panel lines and tiny amber track lights, rocky plain with soft atmospheric haze in distance only, lived-in used future

LIGHT: soft diffuse daylight, tiny hard amber point lights, limited neon bloom inside hollows only, clean high-key daylight, NO night grade

PALETTE CLEAN: bright cyan-blue sky, clear teal-green oxidized metal, charcoal teal-black shadows, amber point lights, pink-purple moon, small mustard yellow and white panel accents, neon pink-cyan only inside hollows, saturated but CLEAN 70s pop sci-fi, midtones stay clear NOT muddy brown-grey wash

CAMERA: low-angle wide 24mm, inhabited cat center-low, moon and ring upper two thirds, large clean sky, deep focus, strong silhouette, 16:9 environment composition

RENDER CRITICAL — CLEAN FINISH: clean digital painting, LARGE FLAT COLOR PLANES, sharp hard-surface edges, crisp silhouettes, details only at seams and edges leave big panels EMPTY and SMOOTH, atmospheric soft brushwork ONLY in distant haze clouds and far scrap NOT on armor or main structures, polished concept art, graphic simplified forms, NO muddy smear, NO dirty grunge overlay, NO soft blurry edges on main subject, NO overpainted weathering noise, NO full-surface rust texture, NO oily smudge, NO watercolor wash, NO painterly smear across metal, NO muddy brown dirt wash

MOOD: awe, lived-in used future, clean optimistic retro sci-fi, extreme scale
negative: muddy colors, dirty smear, smudged brushstrokes, oily paint smear, grunge texture overlay, dirty brown wash, overweathered noise, full-surface rust speckles, soft blurry armor edges, painterly smear on metal, watercolor bleed, muddy midtones, grey-brown mud, photorealistic cat face, realistic fur, tabby stripes, whiskers, cinematic blue night, glowing runes, magic sword glow, monochrome teal-only, octane, unreal engine, hyperrealistic, 8k photo, bokeh, anime, watermark, logo, text
